answer: The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, released only after three unrelated confirmations, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the sparrow of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the umber re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the whisper of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
